text:
Mannheim’s median asking rent sits at 12.54 €/m², up 3.8 % year‑on‑year and 21.2 % over the last five years, placing the city 15th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 60 m² typical apartment costs about 752 € per month, with a rent‑burden of 16.8 % for two residents, while the vacancy rate is low at 1.8 % and listings stay on the market for roughly 28 days; 27 % are let within a week, indicating a balanced market.

Asking rents sit 50 % above the 2022 census existing rent of 8.39 €/m², the market remains tight but affordable relative to national trends, supported by modest population growth of 2.4 % over five years.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 13.08 €/m² in 12 months, with a range of 12.76 – 13.44 €/m², implying a 4.3 % increase.
